body:
# As above, So below II — V2

> V1 is **DELETED**. Current tree: ~55 files / ~10,900 LOC.

## Pitch
Three z-levels (sky / surface / basement) in ONE RimWorld `Map`. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky, (2) performance, (3) full vanilla parity.

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE

One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`. Bands stack along **+z**; `band = surfaceBand + level`; bottom-to-top = basement / surface / sky. Impassable, permanently-fogged **gutter** between bands. `Slot = ceil((bandHeight + 2) / 64) × 64` — **64-alignment is load-bearing** (terrain shaders sample world position).

### Map sizes are CURATED
`Dialog_AdvancedGameConfig.MapSizes` swapped by reflection **for the dialog's duration only** (restored on close; reflection failure falls back to locking). Sizes sit under 64 boundaries where the gutter collapses to 2 rows: **126** (48,384 stacked), **190** (109,440 — cap/default), **254** (195,072 — behind unlock). Old 200 cap wasted 21.9% on gutter. `Clamp` snaps to an *offered* size; the dialog postfix snaps vanilla's 250 default. Labels show **stacked** cells — what `PathGridJob` actually pays.

### The one insight everything rests on
`Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial**. Wormhole `RegionLink`s make distant regions adjacent; both ends `RegionType.Portal` (stairs subclass `Building_Door`), which fails `ShouldBeInTheSameRoom` — connectivity conducts **without merging rooms/temperature/vacuum**. `Reachability.CanReach` works **unpatched** — transitively fixing `ClosestThingReachable`, `RegionTraverser`, storage search, every `WorkGiver_Scanner`. **We patch nothing in `Reachability`/`PathFinder`/region traversal** — the key perf-mod compat guarantee; "patch reachability" suggestions get declined.

### ⚠ Portal regions are ONE CELL
Every door cell is its own Portal region; wormholes must link **every cell pair**. `AB2: band info` prints `links armed = N/M`.

### The dividing line
Graph/logic = **FREE**. Geometry/presentation = **NOT free**; fix at each draw/compute site; never patch `Thing.DrawPos` globally. Third category: **reachability-as-proxy** — fixed at the consumer (`WanderUtility`); un-audited: joy spots, meditation, pens.

### Hard 1.6 constraints
Pathfinder jobified; custom traversal at `Pawn_PathFollower` · no `PathFinder.FindPath` · `BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on unwalkable cells, doors not special-cased.

### Generation-window rules
`ScenParts` (41) spawns colonists during generation (`FindPlayerStartSpot` 40, `Fog` 48). **Carve runs in a `GenerateContentsIntoMap` postfix** — after all gensteps, before `PostMapGenerate`/`FinalizeInit`; `ABBandMap.FinalizeInit` sees `Banded==true` on fresh gen AND load. Genstep-time band math uses `TryPendingSurfaceRect`. Slow-path fallback carves post-init if the in-window patch didn't run.

---

# 2. PER-BAND BIOME — SOLVED, VERIFIED
`map.BiomeAt(cell)` → `MixedBiomeMapComponent.GetBiomeAt` prefixed once; answers from `ABBandEnv.BiomeOf`; non-surface levels only. NOT the ambient-latch pattern — cell is a parameter. Old density postfix **deleted** (would double-apply; hard-zero blocked cavern regrowth). **Compat watch:** perf mods caching biome-per-map would flatten per-cell answers — `AB2: biome report` prints `<-- MISMATCH` if so.

# 3. SKY VEGETATION — VERIFIED
`SeedFlora` at gen; sky biome **LOCKED to surface** (user decision); `fertilityMin` is the species filter; `skyVegetationDensity` setting.

# 4. BIOMES! CAVERNS BASEMENTS
Compat verbatim; carve band-scoped; biome scribed (`basementBiome`); foreign gensteps confined by snapshot+destroy-strays. Earthen Depths 40/30/30 pending test. **Stalagmite-leak check still not done.**

# 5. START SPOT & SOLID-ROCK TILES — CLOSED
Clamp at `GenStep_FindPlayerStartSpot` (24-cell pod margin) + `RescueStrandedColonists` (moves, never destroys). `TryFindStartCell`: radial pass + **full-band sweep** + trustworthy census (counters reset between passes). **Mountain tiles:** vanilla elevation noise has **no edge falloff** and fixed frequency; the surface band is a 190-row window from a 576-row field, so on Mountainous tiles the whole window can exceed the rock threshold (recurred runs #115/#121/#122 — census `100% edifice, 0 water`). **Fix: `CarveStartClearing`** — radius-24 pocket (= pod scatter margin) at the band centre, **roof cleared too** (unsupported thick roof would collapse onto the colony); `GenStep_Fog` (48) then unfogs naturally. Mountain-base start; known limitation: surface x-edges still rock on such tiles (raids arrive as pods/sappers until mined out). Real fix remains transplant. **Fired correctly in play (run #122).**

# 6. CAMERA — ALL VERIFIED
viewBand on the component (uniqueID-keyed static dict leaked across games) · free pan via `CurrentViewRect` clip (one choke point covers MapDrawer + Burst cull; memoized; gated; never degenerate) · **`ABBandCurtain`** draws `map.MapEdgeMaterial` at `WorldClipper` altitude — the camera never clears, unwritten pixels are undefined GPU memory; two hardcoded colours failed before reusing the engine's material (float-Color colour-space trap; render queue beats altitude).

# 7. MAP GENERATION — PROFILED, OPTIMIZED ~4×, CLOSED (2026-07-28)

**`ABGenProfile`**: pairs vanilla's own `DeepProfiler` genstep brackets (depth-counted, thread-pinned, armed only during banded gen) + per-phase carve stopwatches + op counters. One self-reporting `Log.Warning` per generation.

**The investigation, kept honest — four theories, each measured:**
1. *Deferred bookkeeping* (in-window carve): kept for correctness (single region build, `FinalizeInit` consistency) but did NOT collapse cost.
2. *Own-patch overhead* (`ABSkySync` suspended during carve): real, ~15% on FillRock only.
3. *Spawn-then-destroy waste* (keep vanilla's rock when def-matches): correct but tile-dependent (878/36k on open tiles, more on rocky).
4. **The actual mechanism: map crowdedness.** `ListerThings.Remove` is a linear `List.Remove` over ~100k-thing lists, paid per destroy. Per-op cost — the only tile-independent number — was ~0.19 ms crowded vs **~0.03 ms uncrowded, 7× on identical code**.

**The decisive fix: don't generate doomed content.** `Patch_WildPlantSpawner_ABSkipDoomedBands` prefixes `CheckSpawnWildPlantAt` (per-cell probabilistic ⇒ no count concentration ⇒ safe) during banded gen only. Plants genstep 3,329→~surface-only; destroys 41,660→~9k; **carve 16.9 s → ~4.2 s on comparable tiles**. **Scatterer scoping deliberately NOT attempted** — counts derive from `map.Area`; scoping without count-scaling concentrates 3× density.

Remaining known waste (documented, not worth it unless gen still feels slow): cavern spawn-then-hollow (~300–400 ms), `RockChunks` scoping (needs count math).

# 8. RUNTIME PERF (measured, 96 pawns)
fps 59.6 vsync-pinned, tps 98.7%. Mod ≈ 2% frame budget / 18 patches. `CompOf` one-entry front cache (immutable object — worker threads would read two statics torn). Temperature patch resolves comp once (719k calls). `ABSkySync` confirmed event-driven-free. Phase-skip in below-draw tried and **REVERTED** (regression; site comment forbids re-attempt without measurement). `DrawDynamicThings` 458 ms figure contaminated (nested arming); isolated run still pending. Verdict: no further micro-opt needed.

# 9. SKY SYNC
Event-driven (`SetRoof`, `EdificeGrid.Register/DeRegister`); **suspended during carve** (redundant; SkyBandGen derives final state). Precedence: constructed roof (walkable) BEATS impassable edifice (`AB_WallTop`, buildable-not-walkable, **dontRender + `ABBands.ShowsBelow`** — the top of a wall IS the wall; two painted-texture attempts failed first). `ShowsBelow` deliberately NOT used by combat's hole test. Only the four derived terrains ever rewritten. Pre-existing walls need a re-trigger; load pass offered, not requested.

# 10. BELOW-DRAW
Mesh layer carries printed things; `ABBelowDynamicDraw` draws pawns + non-pawn realtime things from `DrawThings` (frames RealtimeOnly; door blueprints forced RealtimeOnly — the "arbitrary" tell; projectiles same fix). All three phases unconditionally (8 vanilla types render pawns inside themselves). Early-out when no band below.

# 11. STAIRS — ALL STALLS RESOLVED (three stacked bugs)
(1) `tickerType Never` ⇒ door could never open ⇒ `openInt` forced in SpawnSetup. (2) 2×2 counterpart rotation (even dimensions shift `OccupiedRect`; counterpart now spawns with matching rotation; `TryCellPairs` compares width/height). (3) landing pocket = footprint for 3×3 (now `ExpandedBy(LandingRadius)`). Plus `PlaceWorker_ABLinkApproach` (≥1 cardinal approach; Mine designations count; planned walls block; **`placeWorkers` REPLACES on inherit — `DoorLearnOpeningSpeed` restated**). `Carry` latent hole (landing exactly on realDest) unfixed. `LayDown` ×1 error noted, plausibly mid-job teleport; transit-log correlation would confirm.

# 12. DIAGNOSTICS
band info · transit health · below pawn report · why is this pawn stuck · ABStuckWatchdog (verdict-contradiction bug unfixed: inspects `nextCell` AFTER reset) · transit logging · below layer report · lighting report · bisect toggles · biome report · shader report · **ABGenProfile** (auto).

# 13. OPEN WORK
- **COMBAT — the largest untested surface.** 575 LOC implemented, never verified. Projectiles below now draw; upward shots still invisible (see-below only looks down).
- Lush worst-case gen profile recorded at 4.2 s on comparable tile; strict lush A/B never captured (acceptable).
- Isolated `DrawDynamicThings` run · compat audit (perf-mod biome caching) · Earthen Depths temp · stalagmite leak · elevator (two counterparts) · **transplant** (fixes coastline AND mountain-window slicing; inland tiles until then) · reachability-as-proxy audit.

# 14. LESSONS (telegraphic)
Classify by behaviour, not directory · a surprising benchmark is usually broken · nested instrumentation inflates outer timings · comparing generation totals across tiles compares tiles (Plants varied 12× between tiles) · per-op cost is the tile-independent number · **crowdedness drives destroy cost (linear lister removal); don't generate doomed content** · per-cell probabilistic gensteps scope safely, `map.Area`-count scatterers do NOT · `GetBodyPos` discards drawLoc in beds · `RenderPawnAt` self-heals only when `!results.valid` · malformed About.xml silently drops a mod · never mutate an enumerated collection · verdicts contradicting their own data are worse than none · **reuse the engine's object instead of reproducing its output** (BiomeAt, CurrentViewRect, MapEdgeMaterial) · distrust confident ordering comments · statics keyed by game-scoped ids leak · "nothing drawn" ≠ black · altitude ≠ draw order · float Color ≠ Color32 · Unity errors bypass the bridge · vanilla elevation noise has no edge falloff — window-slicing a tall map loses vanilla's implicit guarantees · **measure, don't reason: four gen-perf theories in a row were each mostly wrong.**

# 15. PUBLISHING
Live Workshop item **3773267907** with **V1's false-claims description** — user-owned, rewrite offered, not accepted. Stale: known-issues.json, ARCHITECTURE.md, HELICOPTER_VIEW.md, V2-HANDOFF.md.

## TESTING RULE
`isolated=true`. Companions: **`astryl.Circinus`** + `astryl.ModernDevTools` + `BiomesTeam.BiomesCaverns` + `BiomesTeam.CoreFramework`. Playing-gated debug actions via Debug Actions menu. New colony for banding. Transit logging + watchdog reset every launch.
